boundary.note: Python model of a v0 inline provider at the public process/drain boundary; no C provider, registry change, public flag or descriptor change.

headroom_peak.description: Tone plus frozen overloaded transient; scalar ceiling cap, never hard clipping.

impulse.description: Isolated impulse at source sample 4000; verifies zero intrinsic delay and one-to-one frame mapping.

interacting_nonlinearity.description: Stateful attack/release control plus peak ceiling and gain clamp on the overloaded transient.
interacting_nonlinearity.note: Smoothing and ceiling interact: the peak cap limits the smoothed target, so the envelope does not reach the RMS target on overloaded frames.

no_gain_control.description: Identity control on the same frozen speech probe; no peak ceiling.

silence.description: All-zero stream: undefined RMS falls back to identity gain, not infinity.

steps.description: Eight 25-frame level steps from -42 dBFS to -6 dBFS and back; static gain cannot track steps.

sweep.description: 20 Hz to 8 kHz exponential sine sweep, static gain calibrated once from the whole probe.

synthetic_speech.description: Frozen 125-frame harmonic/formant surrogate with voiced, unvoiced and pause-floor regions.
synthetic_speech.noise_floor_note: A single static scalar scales voiced and pause-floor content equally; SNR is unchanged and no noise gating is applied.

evidence_classes.source_reported_context: 0.000/3.825/4.414/2.577 dB values in the pinned research note are context only; not rerun or pooled.
evidence_classes.synthetic_paired: Generated here under fixed seeds; both train and held-out splits are synthetic.
